d: Long, flowing auburn hair with straight bangs and two small side-locks is paired with cheerful, almond-shaped golden-olive eyes. The face is that of a teenager with a slender build. The outfit consists of a white long-sleeved shirt under a grey metallic breastplate, a dark navy pleated skirt with gold trim, and a black collar with a red tie. Signature details include a small blue rectangular pin on the chest and large, grey mechanical ship rigging with cannons attached to the back and arms.
